scope: 50 Apple silicon Mac mini, Mac Studio and MacBook families across 12 exterior chassis; one Neo configuration family
published_inputs: Physical width, depth and closed height
Native display resolution and rectangular display extent from published pixel density
Official finish names and port types/counts
photo_estimates: Desktop foot, intake fins, rear perforation pitch and recessed socket internals
Port center positions and socket opening sizes
Separate lid/base thickness and 0.6 mm hinge clearance
US keycap, speaker and trackpad layout dimensions
Apple inlay size, aluminum RGB/roughness and finish-toned logo reflectance

implementation.desktop: Screenless static model with actual shallow socket cuts, separate underside foot/intake and centered top Apple inlay. Old mini has black rear I/O insert; Studio has a recessed perforated rear sheet.
implementation.laptop: Rigid X-axis Fold clip from open to closed. Native screen UVs remain fixed and notch geometry actually excludes OLED triangles. Apple inlay is on the exterior lid only.
implementation.normals: Machined planar walls remain flat after Boolean port cuts; curved fillets are smooth. This avoids diagonal reflection fans across the front.
implementation.branding: Existing Apple vector contour retains its 0.814036673 width/height ratio, including separate leaf.
implementation.reviews: Chip-only variants with identical physical dimensions, display, port layout and palette reuse canonical PNG review images; each GLB retains its own device identity.
implementation.webgl_surfaces: Actual display opening in the black cover, recessed keyboard and trackpad pockets, and recessed perforated speaker sheets avoid nearly coplanar overlaps in browser depth buffers.
implementation.intake_finish: Compact mini fins and Studio circular foot/intake use charcoal polymer with dielectric highlights. Studio has a tapered perforated band with open holes; pitch, taper and hole dimensions are visual estimates. The gallery provides an underside inspection view.

limitations: These procedural models are not Apple CAD or dimensional metrology.
US keyboard artwork is representative; ISO/JIS key arrangements and functional Touch Bar content are not modeled.
Neo keycaps are finish-tinted and its trackpad is described as mechanical Multi-Touch; force mechanics are not simulated.
Neo right side speaker slit is supported by a close-up. The inferred left slit is omitted because the proposed coordinates overlap documented USB-C sockets.
Socket shells are recessed and recognizable; connector pinouts and internal board assemblies are illustrative.

Studio intake band is a reference-based approximation of Apple's bottom perforations, not an exact manufacturing hole count or CAD contour. Reference: https://www.apple.com/cf/newsroom/2022/03/apple-unveils-all-new-mac-studio-and-studio-display/
